versions.changelog:
- Removes instructions for rewards claiming confirmation and deactivation reward recommendations.
- Updates tool routing table: removes "Claim rewards" intent and its associated tool.
- Updates confirmation flow: removes explicit confirmation and reward destination for rewards claiming actions; now only withdrawals and deactivation require extra confirmation.
- Updates proactive follow-up examples to omit reward claims after withdrawal and instead focus on portfolio, APR, and onboarding flows.
- Simplifies description and onboarding steps; reduces mentions of rewards in favor of portfolio and earning focus.

- Removed "openclaw" environment variable metadata from the SKILL.md.
- Clarified and simplified introductory language in the description.
- No changes to feature set or end-user experience—content edits only.

Initial release of the giza skill for DeFi yield management.

- Enables user onboarding, portfolio reviews, withdrawals, rewards management, optimization, and education for Giza users.
- Connects seamlessly to the Giza MCP server for autonomous stablecoin yield across Base, Arbitrum, Plasma, and HyperEVM networks.
- Provides clear, consumer-friendly guidance with dynamic tone adjustment for technical users.
- Implements robust authentication, confirmation, and error recovery flows.
- Proactively suggests next steps after each interaction.
- Base network is set as the default with explanations and recommendations for new users.
